review_title: Process mining for agentic AI - 2026 literature (integrative/scoping)

exclusion_codes.label: Not a research, survey or position paper (blog, vendor page, news, tutorial, dataset card)
System studied is not an LLM-based / generative AI agentic system
LLMs/agents used to perform process mining on ordinary logs; agents' own behaviour not analysed
No treatment of agent behaviour as process/trace data and no link to process models

core_criteria: agent behaviour treated as process or trace data, or linked to process models

personas.A: You are REVIEWER A, a process mining researcher with expertise in event data, process discovery and conformance checking, who also follows LLM agent research.
personas.B: You are REVIEWER B, a literature-review methodologist experienced in scoping and integrative reviews in computer science and information systems.
